messages.plaintextBody:
James - separate matter, but when you get a moment can you cast an eye over the field-of-use carve-out in the Penrose Robotics licence (Project Cedar)? Client wants our view before Friday. Nothing to do with Solstice - just need a second pair of eyes. Thanks.

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
